evals.name: agents-list-url-state-fetching-memoization
evals.prompt: Review this React component before it is merged. List every real problem you find, each with the file line, a severity (critical/high/medium) and a concrete fix. Do not edit the file and do not report style nitpicks.
evals.expected_output: Three findings: filter/pagination state kept in useState instead of URL search params, data fetched with axios inside a component effect without AbortController and outside a custom hook, and needless useMemo/useCallback on trivial work.
expectations: Reports that `query`, `status` and `page` are URL-dependent state (filters/pagination) and belong in URL search params, not useState

Reports that the axios request is made directly in the component's useEffect: it has no AbortController/cleanup (race between responses) and data fetching should live in a custom hook such as the project's useApiQuery
Reports that `displayName` useMemo (string concatenation) and the `handleQueryChange` useCallback (passed to a DOM input, not a memo child) are unnecessary memoization
Rates the URL-state finding and the fetch/abort finding as high, not low

evals.name: app-providers-context-wrapper-forwardref
evals.prompt: Review this React component before it is merged. List every real problem you find, each with the file line, a severity (critical/high/medium) and a concrete fix. Do not edit the file and do not report style nitpicks.
evals.expected_output: Three findings: one god Context holding unrelated state (user, theme, toasts, sidebar) that re-renders all consumers, a wrapper component that only calls a hook and returns null, and forwardRef used under React 19.
expectations: Reports that AppContext mixes unrelated concerns (user, theme, toasts, sidebar) so every consumer re-renders on any change, and recommends splitting contexts by concern or moving local UI state out of Context
Reports that `PageViewTracker` only calls a hook/effect and renders null, so it is an unnecessary wrapper component and the tracking should be a hook called directly
Reports that `TextInput` uses forwardRef, which is unnecessary in React 19 where ref is a regular prop
Rates the Context misuse and the wrapper component as critical or high, and forwardRef as medium

evals.name: pr-detail-nested-ternary-inline-style-error-boundary
evals.prompt: Review this React component before it is merged. List every real problem you find, each with the file line, a severity (critical/high/medium) and a concrete fix. Do not edit the file and do not report style nitpicks.
evals.expected_output: Three findings: nested ternary chain for loading/error/empty/success states instead of early returns, inline style={} object instead of Tailwind utilities, and an ErrorBoundary without resetKeys and without a Try again button.
expectations: Reports the three-level nested ternary for loading/error/empty/success and recommends early returns or extracted components
Reports the inline `style={{ ... }}` object on the paragraph and recommends Tailwind utility classes
Reports that the ErrorBoundary has no `resetKeys` (for example [pathname]) and that CrashFallback has no 'Try again' button calling resetErrorBoundary
Rates the nested ternary and the error-boundary findings as high, and the inline style as medium

evals.name: overview-tab-real-diff-pr-brief
evals.prompt: Review this diff from a merged pull request. List every real problem you find, each with the added line it concerns, a severity (critical/high/medium) and a concrete fix. Do not report style nitpicks and do not invent problems: if something is fine, leave it out.
evals.expected_output: Real diff of OverviewTab.tsx from commit e4a6f19 (PR Brief). Findings under this skill: a trivial-cost useMemo (new Set over files), the intent/risk-areas branching that tests `brief` twice and builds JSX in render-body variables, and a presentational tab that now fetches data itself.
expectations: Reports that the `changedPaths` useMemo (`new Set(files.map((f) => f.path))`) is unnecessary memoization because building the set is cheap, and quotes that line

Reports that the `intent` expression `brief && !brief.intent ? riskAreas : <IntentCard ... footer={brief ? riskAreas : undefined} />` tests `brief` twice and assigns JSX to local variables in the render body, and recommends an extracted component or explicit early branches

Reports that OverviewTab now calls the data hooks `usePrBrief` and `usePrReviews` itself while also laying out cards, mixing container and presentational work, and recommends moving the fetching into the parent or a dedicated container

evals.name: overview-tab-negative-critical-only
evals.prompt: Review this diff from a merged pull request, but report ONLY CRITICAL issues: bugs, broken reconciliation, derived state stored in useState, render factories (camelCase functions returning JSX), unstable or index keys, or a falsy `0` rendered by `{count && ...}`. If there are none, say so explicitly instead of listing lower-severity items.
evals.expected_output: The diff has no critical issue, so the answer is an explicit 'no critical issues' verdict that names the categories it checked.
expectations: Contains an explicit sentence stating that no CRITICAL issue was found in the diff, and quotes it
Names at least three of the checked CRITICAL categories (derived state in useState, render factories, keys, falsy-0 rendering) and states that none of them occurs in the diff
